title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
ii.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
iii.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
iv.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
v.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
colophon: a skyline that blinks back; each refresh, a city that never was.
